# Project Atlas brief

Date: 2026-10-30

## Goals

- Let a dispatcher build a delivery-performance report in under ten minutes,
  without writing queries.
- Ship the five most-requested reports as ready-made templates.
- Reach ten paying teams within three months of the public release.

## Team

Tobias Renn is the delivery lead for Project Atlas. He owns the launch
timeline and the pilot schedule.

## Out of scope

Real-time tracking and mobile apps are out of scope for the first release.
